expressions.cue: A load has a stated mass of three metric tonnes. Write it using the katakana unit トン and kanji or Arabic numerals, without converting to kilograms.
expressions.explanation: In the specified metric system, one トン is 1,000 kilograms, not 1,000 tons. The answer preserves the supplied three-ton quantity; it does not count trucks or claim that every foreign unit called a ton has the same mass.
